Package logic

Class Restaurant

java.lang.Object
logic.Restaurant
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Restaurant extends Object implements Serializable
The Restaurant class represents a restaurant entity in a restaurant management system. It includes details such as the restaurant's ID, name, address, and branch. The class implements Serializable to allow instances of Restaurant to be serialized for storage or transmission.

The class provides a default constructor and a parameterized constructor for creating a restaurant with specified attributes. It also includes standard getters and setters for accessing and modifying the restaurant's properties.

Example usage: 

 
 Restaurant restaurant = new Restaurant(1, "The Food Place", "123 Main St", "Downtown");
 System.out.println(restaurant);
